subject: Bridgeway hands-on lab sprint — pilot plan
messages:
From: Samir Shah <samir@bridgeway.io>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Morales <elena@bridgeway.io>
Date: 2027-03-30T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Bridgeway x Redwood — pilot: hands-on lab sprint proposal

Hi Olga,

Thanks for taking a call yesterday. Bridgeway would like to pilot a co-hosted "hands-on lab sprint" for our joint customers — a 90-minute remote workshop where attendees bring a small dataset and follow step-by-step integration with Redwood Inference. Our goals: 1) accelerate product adoption, 2) capture two short success stories, and 3) create a repeatable lab kit for partners.

High-level ask from Bridgeway:
- Two Redwood engineers as live co-instructors (30–45m each)
- A short joint deck + lab repo we can reference
- Marketing support: registration page, email invite, social posts

Target pilot date range: Apr 19–23. Estimated attendees: 30–50. We can cover modest sponsor costs and handle registration via our platform. Attached a draft agenda and a one-page pilot summary.

Thoughts? If that window works I can share proposed times.

Cheers,
Samir
Director, Partnerships — Bridgeway
[Attachment: Bridgeway_Agenda_v1.pdf (PDF)]

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir@bridgeway.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-30T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Bridgeway x Redwood — pilot: hands-on lab sprint proposal

Samir — this aligns well with Redwood’s pilot approach. We can commit two engineers for live instruction and we’ll produce the lab repo + short how-to doc. A few quick clarifying Qs before we lock dates:

1) Audience profile: are these technical leads, data engineers, or product managers?
2) Is the ask that attendees have their own GPU environment, or can we provide a hosted sandbox?
3) How will Bridgeway handle recording/rights for reuse as a marketing asset?

Marissa, tagging you for marketing cadence and collateral deadlines. I attached a skeleton agenda with proposed instructor blocks — will update after Samir confirms environment and attendee level.

Next step: if Apr 19–23 works, can we pick two slots (one mid-week, one late-week) so we can A/B test timing?

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Senior Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
--
Redwood Inference — Developer-first LLM inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Samir Shah <samir@bridgeway.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-31T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Bridgeway x Redwood — pilot: hands-on lab sprint proposal

All — happy to run comms. Quick notes:
- We prefer a mid-week slot (Wed) 10am PT for best registration conversion.
- Collateral deadlines: final deck + lab repo by Apr 7; email copy and landing page by Apr 10.
- Promotion plan: joint landing page, 2 emails (invite + reminder), LinkedIn event, and a co-authored follow-up blog + short clipables.

Marissa
Director, Field Marketing — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_Marketing_Brief.docx (DOCX)]

From: Samir Shah <samir@bridgeway.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Morales <elena@bridgeway.io>
Date: 2027-04-01T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Bridgeway x Redwood — pilot: hands-on lab sprint proposal

Perfect — Wed Apr 21 10am PT works for us. Audience will be solution architects and platform engineers (we’ll gate registration to ensure technical fit).

Answers:
- Attendees can use our hosted sandbox (we’ll provision instances with small GPUs and temporary creds).
- We’re happy for Redwood to record; Bridgeway requests a 30-day embargo before public reuse for privacy checks.
- I attached a brief LOI that our legal team prefers to use as a starting point — nothing heavy, just roles/responsibilities and data handling bullets.

Samir
[Attachment: Bridgeway_LOI_draft.pdf (PDF)]

- Redwood (Olga + 2 engs): final slides + lab repo due Apr 7 (done) — lab repo link: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/handson-lab-assets

Olga Petrov
